AMAT, a key player in the notable recent performance for a top dividend fund, is scheduled to report fiscal third-quarter earnings after the closing bell on Thursday. Analysts forecast EPS of $3.39 (+36.7% YoY) on revenue of $9.01 billion (+23.4% YoY) for the equipment supplier.

Stifel analysts Brian Chin and Daniela Talio reiterated their Buy rating and their $650 12-month target price

Track all markets on TradingView [...] Wall Street expects Cisco to report fiscal fourth-quarter EPS of $1.17 (+18.2% YoY) on revenue of $16.83 billion (+14.7% YoY) after the closing bell on Wednesday.
